Landing the carrier through the pinned promotion path is the correct Product objective for this cycle.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: The program has converged on one decisive missing proof (a real external LLM agent paying measurably less end-to-end cost per successful, partially novel Web task because SPIDER lets it inherit mechanisms) and on exactly THREE named readiness prerequisites for it: (B1) the audited parameterized-inheritance carrier must land on the SHIPPED kernel path through the pinned promotion path; (B2) a task bank with genuine non-ceiling comparator dynamic range and a real treatment/comparator distinction must be certified before freeze; (B3) a same-model endpoint/runtime that can actually drive the minimal multi-step Web-agent test must be proven or the credential-free path explicitly closed/re-scoped. All three currently have active pre-freeze work (Product EXP-PRODUCT-38051422731, Runtime EXP-RUNTIME-38051419597, Intel EXP-INTEL-38013769440). This cycle is therefore NOT a moment to open new basins; the highest-value move is to let those three decisive prerequisite steps complete, because each can remove a blocker that today forces every downstream C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY / C-PRODUCT-ECON attempt into a non-identifying or measurement-invalid packet. Physics holds a genuinely FROZEN real-Web experiment (EXP-PHYSICS-37992957068, access-barrier onset/recovery) which must be completed under its frozen design and is a materially new observable after the value-level persistence sub-hypothesis (H1) was rejected. Graph's C-FRESHNESS pre-freeze certificate is one decisive step from resolving a long-running single-anchor/transport-coupled D1V degeneracy: positive unblocks a real multi-anchor guard false-accept measurement, negative fails loudly and parks the four-anchor Part II route and redirects freshness. Frontier's v2 re-design measures a question (site-native discovery vs apparent BFS depth cost) that was never measured at all because v1 froze an empty sampling frame. No lane is idle; no already-frozen transaction is being redirected. The single largest governance inefficiency remains spending cycles on designs that later prove non-identifying, comparator-degenerate or prerequisite-blocked; the three-prerequisite concentration above is the direct response.
